metaDescription: AYAS dance directions, classes, and programs, with what each offers, the age group, and the level.

hero.title: Courses
hero.lead: Every dance direction, class, and program at the school is here. Compare what each program offers, the age group, and the level, then choose the class that fits you.

empty: No class matches this combination. Change the direction, age, or level.

programs.title: Classical ballet for children
programs.summary: First positions, musicality, and a load that fits the age. Through play, a child learns order and a first experience of the stage.

programs.title: Classical ballet for teens
programs.summary: Barre, center, and stage preparation. The class deepens technique and prepares a performance.

programs.title: Classical ballet for adults
programs.summary: Technique for people starting or returning to dance. The class respects the body's experience and moves toward expression.

programs.title: Contemporary dance
programs.summary: Floor work, improvisation, and a personal voice. For students who want movement to become their own language.

programs.title: Traditional dance for children
programs.summary: Armenian dance through pattern, play, and ensemble. A child learns the order of movement and a first stage presence.

programs.title: Traditional dance for adults
programs.summary: Ensemble work and stage repertoire. The class deepens traditional technique and prepares a performance.

programs.title: Open class
programs.summary: A way to meet the school, the studio, and a teacher before choosing a group. One visit, without a long commitment.

programs.title: Stage preparation
programs.summary: Rehearsals that carry classwork to an audience. For students who already have technique and are preparing to perform.
